questions.question: In a song about enemies who persecuted Israel since its youth, what does Israel say about those enemies?

answers.text: They have not prevailed against Israel
They drove Israel far from home

questions.question: In a song about being persecuted since youth, Israel calls the LORD righteous. True or false?
In a song about long persecution, what does Israel say the LORD has done for them?

answers.text: Cut Israel from the cords of the wicked
Taught Israel to plow its own fields
Told Israel to wait a little longer

questions.question: In a song of Israel, what does the writer wish for all who hate Zion?

answers.text: That they be turned back in shame
That they be welcomed into Zion
That they be made rulers of Zion
